baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future verb سَيَعْلَمُونَ is preceded by the sequencing particle ثُمَّ and the rebuff كَلَّا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A presently resisted or unavailable matter passes through a marked interval and becomes clear to the addressed collective; the rebuff makes their later cognition corrective rather than neutral.

activation_trace.role: The image of a thing becoming clear grounds the future verb as eventual disclosure that corrects a present stance.

changed_reading.before: A bare prediction that they will know later.
changed_reading.after: After a marked interval, what they presently resist will become clear to them as a correction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَيَعْلَمُونَ carries the focus root ع ل م, whose inventory includes both cognition and a distinguishing mark that guides.
baseline_models.mechanism: Future knowing can be activated as recognition: a decisive mark makes the denied matter identifiable, so cognition is mediated by something that points beyond itself.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing-mark image turns inward knowledge into recognition guided by an outwardly discriminating sign.

changed_reading.before: Their future knowledge is only an inward mental state.
changed_reading.after: They may come to know by confronting a mark that makes the denied reality unmistakable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mutual questioning circulates a report among parties taking divergent paths; against that social field, the focus prediction changes from unspecified cognition into the forced resolution of a publicly disputed report.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure in the focus supplies the endpoint that replaces unresolved circulation with clarity.
Mutual questioning supplies a social loop in which knowledge is currently sought and exchanged without settlement.
The arriving, communicated report supplies the contested object that later becomes clear.
Parties taking different paths makes the present epistemic condition divergence rather than simple ignorance.

structural_cues: 78:1-3 moves in order from reciprocal questioning to the great report to disagreement immediately before the two predictions of knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioning, an arriving report, divergence, and later disclosure; I infer that disclosure terminates the divergence. A live alternative is that the future verb threatens each party without implying convergence between them.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified fact will eventually become clear.
changed_reading.after: The report now circulating through questions and rival positions will cease to be disputable when disclosure overtakes the disputants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context gives the same rebuff-plus-future-disclosure clause in 78:4, while the focus repeats it with ثُمَّ added. The second occurrence therefore behaves as a staged or escalated disclosure rather than redundant emphasis alone.

activation_trace.role: Focus disclosure is the second member of the duplicated cognition sequence.
The immediately prior disclosure clause supplies a first threshold against which the focus becomes a later or more forceful threshold.

structural_cues: 78:4 is كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ; 78:5 repeats it after adding ثُمَّ.
The future prefix is repeated rather than shared across a coordinated pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact clause repetition plus an added sequencer; I infer two thresholds or a second-order intensification. The live alternative is rhetorical escalation with no distinct chronology.

changed_reading.before: The focus simply restates that they will know.
changed_reading.after: The focus announces a second threshold of disclosure, or a disclosure whose force exceeds the first warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded day, judicial separation, and a struck appointment give the focus future a horizon: knowing occurs when previously mixed claims are separated and their boundary is made manifest.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies disclosure whose timing and discriminating function are sharpened by the later appointment.
A delimited span of time gives ثُمَّ a concrete event horizon rather than indefinite postponement.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood makes later knowing discriminative and verdict-like.
A fixed appointment converts the vague future into a scheduled threshold.

structural_cues: 78:17 formally opens the judgment sequence by naming the day of separation as an appointment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later fixed day whose function is separation; I map the focus future onto that horizon and its function. A live alternative is that 78:17 specifies only one realization of a warning that may begin earlier.

changed_reading.before: They will know at some unspecified later time.
changed_reading.after: Their knowing reaches a fixed threshold where truth and falsehood are separated by verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: Experience, act-for-consequence exchange, exact fit, accounting, exhaustive enumeration, and binding inscription form an evidentiary pipeline. The focus knowing becomes verification through an outcome that matches an exhaustively recorded history.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure in the focus becomes the cognitive result of the accounting-and-consequence pipeline.
Experiencing and undergoing a thing makes the eventual knowledge embodied rather than merely propositional.
Answering an act with its consequence supplies the causal link between prior conduct and later disclosure.
A measure equal to its counterpart makes the consequence legible as a fitted answer rather than arbitrary force.
Counting and reckoning names the evaluative operation they had not expected.
Enumeration to exhaustion removes evidentiary gaps through which denial could persist.
Binding inscription turns the exhaustive inventory into an operative judgment.

structural_cues: 78:26-30 moves from fitted recompense through rejected reckoning and denial to exhaustive inscription and the imperative to taste.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching consequence, reckoning, exhaustive record, and experience; I infer that their convergence is the means by which the focus knowledge becomes undeniable. A live alternative is that these are consequences after cognition rather than its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They will intellectually recognize that the warning was true.
changed_reading.after: They will know by undergoing a precisely matched consequence whose complete record explains why it fits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening questioning and disagreement give way to inability to command address, a ban on speech except by permission, a right utterance, and finally the unbeliever's spoken wish. Knowing is thus accompanied by collapse of argumentative speech into constrained, truth-aligned utterance and belated confession.

activation_trace.role: Future disclosure supplies the change in cognition that the later speech regime makes audible.
Conversational address is explicitly unavailable, closing the earlier field of mutual questioning.
Intelligible speech between speakers is withheld except under permission, removing free argumentative exchange.
Permitted vocal utterance supplies the narrow channel through which disclosed truth may be voiced.
The unbeliever's final voiced wish turns corrected knowledge into a belated confession of irreversible loss.
Rightness settled opposite error defines the truth-aligned content allowed through the restricted speech channel.

structural_cues: The surah begins with reciprocal questioning but ends with no possessed address, no speech except by permission, and one final regretful utterance.
78:38 places speaking rightly inside an exception to general silence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reversal from questioning to constrained right speech and final regret; I infer that this vocal reversal externalizes the focus disclosure. A live alternative is that the speech rules describe judgment decorum without modifying the sense of knowing.

changed_reading.before: Their later knowledge remains private cognition.
changed_reading.after: Their knowledge coincides with the loss of argumentative speech and surfaces only as truth-constrained utterance or belated confession.

context_deltas.mechanism: A warning meant to awaken caution is declared near; then a person directs sight or insight toward what was advanced by their own hands. The focus disclosure becomes self-recognition before evidence authored by the knower's own agency.

activation_trace.role: The focus disclosure is concretized as recognition when the subject confronts personal evidence.
A warning that awakens caution establishes that the later disclosure was announced in advance.
Nearness compresses the apparent delay in ثُمَّ and makes the disclosure impending rather than safely remote.
Directed sight or insight supplies the immediate act through which the person apprehends the evidence.
Advancing something ahead makes past action arrive first as the object waiting to be seen.
What the hands earned identifies the evidence as the person's own production rather than an alien accusation.

structural_cues: 78:40 closes the whole-surah window by joining near warning, looking, what was sent ahead, the two hands, and the unbeliever's regret in one scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior warning, nearness, directed apprehension, and hand-authored prior action; I infer that seeing one's own action is the decisive disclosure promised in the focus. A live alternative is that the sight follows an already completed act of knowing.

changed_reading.before: The truth will be imposed on them from outside.
changed_reading.after: They will know by facing evidence they themselves sent ahead, so the disclosure is simultaneously external encounter and self-recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's nominal mark-and-guidance branch under an ordinary cognition verb and reads landscape reversal epistemically. It remains anchored in سَيَعْلَمُونَ through branch B002 and in the packet's repeated mountain followed by explicit mirage. Downstream prose should present it as a secondary spatial image of failed orientation, not as a replacement lexical gloss for the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ع ل م inventory at 78:5 includes a distinguishing mark that guides, allowing the focus knowing to be tested as orientation by visible markers.

activation_trace.role: The guiding-mark image supplies the focus-side bridge from cognition to spatial orientation.
A high solid mass supplies a paradigmatic stable landmark in the created order.
The same solid landmark is repeated at the point where its apparent stability is reversed.
The water-like gleam of mirage converts the stable marker into deceptive appearance and forces reorientation.

changed_reading.before: They will know while the ordinary signs by which they orient remain intact.
changed_reading.after: They will know through the collapse of a familiar landmark into deceptive appearance, when inherited orientation can no longer sustain denial.

strongest_changes: The opening questioning, report, and divergence revise generic future cognition into resolution of a disputed public claim.
The exact 78:4 repetition plus added ثُمَّ makes the focus a second or intensified disclosure threshold.
The appointed day of separation gives the future disclosure a fixed, discriminating horizon.
Matched consequence, exhaustive record, and the sight of hand-authored deeds make knowing experiential and self-evidencing.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converts knowledge from a prediction into mechanisms: dispute is terminated, claims are separated, records are made operative, consequences are undergone, speech is constrained, and personal action becomes visible evidence. These mechanisms coexist rather than collapse into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: ثُمَّ may mark two chronological disclosures, rhetorical escalation, or both.
The accounting and sight sequences may be means of knowing or consequences that follow cognition already achieved.
The landmark-to-mirage reading is visibly anchored but remains branch-distant from the ordinary verbal sense of عَلِمَ.
